criteria.requirement: For each of the five skills the agent card declares (check, verify, conditions, is-verified, lookup), the observation file records a probe of the card's public A2A interface with a JSON-RPC 2.0 result (not an error) whose content addresses that skill's stated purpose. Name any skill that did not answer.
criteria.title: Declared skills answer

criteria.requirement: The card declares that no skill needs credentials (the A2A interface is public) and that operator-only routes need the x-sweep-token header. The observation file shows the A2A probes answered without any credential, and an operator-only route (POST /sweep) refused a request that carried no token.
criteria.title: Auth behaves as declared

criteria.requirement: The card bytes in the observation file declare a provider and a compensation disclosure (who pays the agent).
criteria.title: Disclosure present

note: Pre-terms agent-card check for the MUSUBI contract kit (a2aproject/A2A discussion 2306). The record's findings say what was observed, not that the card is trustworthy.
